description: Checks that the Video Indexer account name is valid and is not already in use.

operations.description: Checks that the Video Indexer account name is valid and is not already in use.

schema.description: The parameters used to check the availability of the Video Indexer account name.
schema.name: checkNameAvailabilityParameters

params.description: The ID of the target subscription.
params.name: subscriptionId

consts.description: The API version to use for this operation.
consts.name: api-version

props.description: Gets an error message explaining the Reason value in more detail.
props.name: message

props.description: Gets a boolean value that indicates whether the name is available for you to use. If true, the name is available. If false, the name has already been taken.
props.name: nameAvailable

props.description: Gets the reason that a Video Indexer account name could not be used. The Reason element is only returned if NameAvailable is false.
props.name: reason

responses.description: OK - Operation to check the Video Indexer account name availability was successful. Ok does not indicate the name is available, the body of the response does.
Error response describing why the operation failed.
